description: Comments which go at the top of a table in Nuclear Data Sheets.  Columns can only take values which actually appear as a column in the table, not properties printed in the 'comments' column.  Rows refers to an individual entry (be it a level, gamma, etc) in the table.  If the 'rows' property does not appear, then the comment appears as a footnote on the listed columns.  If 'columns' does not appear, it appears as a comment at the top of the table.

columns.description: Indicates the column (e.g. energy, multipolarity) in the table to which this comment applies and on which a footnote will appear.  If this is not present, the comment will appear at the top of the table rather than as a footnote.  Allowable entries are specified in-place.

items.description: Entries in this array correspond to the rows in the corresponding column to which the comment applies.  An empty array indicates that the comment applies to the entire column.
